goal: Wave 3 build: Org domain rules on fetch and search, Quarry re-check; Effective-policy origin read; Retention sweeper, dry-run; Holds against user delete and erasure; One lint on every skill write path; Widget prompt notice and the inline_widgets client feature; Narrow postMessage bridge: size, staged follow-up, safe link; Origin on the user_question event and the question card NOTE: run every pnpm command with the env var pnpm_config_verify_deps_before_run=false. A change to any .proto needs generated code: put the exact buf/regen step in lead_todo instead of hand-editing generated Go files, keep the change additive, and comment every new field and message (buf lint ratchet). NOTE: one model-gateway plus execution-core test build takes most of the free disk, so build only the test targets your slice names; never create a new cargo target directory, use only the given targetDir. NOTE: code first (owner order 2026-11-03): write the code and the unit tests the row names, do not run them; one guard agent compiles after the batch. session-core migrations taken: 0100, 0101, 0103, 0104, 0105 (EP-4-S5), 0106 (EP-12-S14) and any newer file in the migrations folder: take your reserved round-B number if still free, else the next free number; capability-core the next free at or above 0036. Error bodies keep {error:{code,message,details}} with details an object. auth-core has ONE ApiKeyExchangeController serving every audience (merged from main 2026-11-04): extend it, never add a second exchange route.

slices.title: Org domain rules on fetch and search, Quarry re-check
slices.summary: Grants model-gateway and execution-core the org:browser-site:read:any scope, adds a pure host canonicaliser and fetch_allowed in mp-contracts, and per-service resolve clients with a 30 s cache (unreadable = deny). fetch_url/web_fetch is checked before the call (typed org_site_blocked), and search sends the org block list as exclude_domains (max 64) and drops hits on denied hosts. Proto: execution.proto WebPolicyContext.site_policy_revision = 4 (inside the W2 message). No migration. Switch WEB_DOMAIN_POLICY_MODE off|shadow|enforce, default off, unknown = enforce.
slices.remaining: C-B1 (single org web-policy store: w23 organization_web_policy vs DEC-19 browsersites) and D-W1/D-W2 (rules sent per call as a request layer). Quarry half (/v1/extract deny list, policy_rev echo) belongs to the Quarry plan; Model half can build once ruled. [Decisions taken 2026-11-04 at the recommended option (owner).]
